# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-01-24

### Added
- Initial release of XAMPP Apps Dashboard
- Auto-discovery of all PHP applications in htdocs directory
- Beautiful, responsive card-based UI with gradient design
- Smart project detection (looks for index.php or index.html)
- Dynamic icon assignment based on folder names
- Active/Inactive project status badges
- One-click app launching and file browsing
- Mobile-responsive design
- Comprehensive README with installation instructions
- MIT License

### Features
- Scans all directories in htdocs automatically
- Non-destructive installation (preserves existing projects)
- Ignores system folders (webalizer, xampp, .dist, etc.)
- HTML special character escaping for security
- Sorted app list by name
- Direct access to XAMPP tools and original dashboard
